producer.evidence: HIFLD item metadata attributes this layer to FCC and says HIFLD hosted the data as received from the provider.

candidates.portal_created_modified_dates: Portal metadata reports created 2026-08-24T23:19:55Z and modified 2026-08-24T23:20:24Z; service edit time is 2026-08-24T23:20:17Z. These describe the Esri-hosted item/service, not a dataset release date.
candidates.authority_assessment: Item metadata names FCC as accessInformation and says data/details are hosted by HIFLD as received. The item owner is not an identified FCC account; no delegation evidence or source-side publication link was found. Treat as an unverified HIFLD copy, not a maintained FCC feed.

candidates.role: HIFLD Open residual copy under Oregon OEM account; historical/community mirror
candidates.authority_assessment: Description identifies FCC as original data source and HIFLD as host. The item is owned by Oregon OEM, not FCC; it is a mirror, and its old HIFLD service URL returns ArcGIS Invalid URL in this audit.

audit.runtime_evidence_directory: runtime/ (untracked; raw JSON responses, paginated feature pages, SHA-256 hashes)

candidate_service_observations.spatial_reference: Web Mercator service extent; query supports output spatial reference 4326
candidate_service_observations.extraction: 4 pages at result offsets 0, 2000, 4000, 6000; all 6541 records returned; 6541 unique FID values; no null FID; first 3 pages indicated transfer limit and the last page did not
candidate_service_observations.schema: 28 fields in runtime/arcgis_layer.json; FID is the service ObjectID. UniqSysID is nullable esriFieldTypeInteger, so it has not been accepted as a stable agency identity. Source/published value and type contract remains unapproved.
candidate_service_observations.completeness_scope: Complete relative to this ArcGIS service's reported count at retrieval time only; does not prove current FCC source coverage or equivalence to accepted HIFLD Next data.

audit.freshness_conclusion: No source release date or refresh history was verified. A responding service, portal modified timestamp, or complete extraction is not proof of a current agency release.
audit.blocker: No maintained FCC publication or documented official delegation was established. The available live candidate is a HIFLD-labeled hosted copy with unresolved account authority and release lineage. Per issue #265, do not implement an archive-refresh pipeline or promote this candidate as an agency feed.

proposed_raw_schema_contract.status: unapproved; schema snapshot for review only
proposed_raw_schema_contract.preservation: Preserve all 28 source columns with exact names, types, nullability, values, precision, and point geometry. Do not promote FID as an agency identifier or generate replacement IDs. Preserve UniqSysID exactly as nullable integer unless source-specific evidence establishes its contract.
proposed_raw_schema_contract.drift_policy: Any missing/renamed field, type/nullability change, new field, ID behavior change, count/coverage change, or geometry shift requires quarantine and maintainer review.

published_contract.status: pending maintainer approval and accepted-baseline comparison
published_contract.baseline: No accepted HIFLD Next dataset/file/version and checksums verified in this source research.
published_contract.release_gate: Block catalog promotion/publication until approved raw and published schemas, identity rules, provenance, accepted baseline mapping, and compatibility/migration plan are recorded.

refresh_and_idempotency.completeness_gate: Unresolved until a maintained official/delegated endpoint and a stable agency identity/release marker are verified.
refresh_and_idempotency.quarantine: Do not replace an accepted release when a source is incomplete, unavailable, schema-drifted, or cannot be authenticated as the intended upstream. Retain the prior accepted release and candidate evidence.
